name: Exage road platform pedals
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed reference for a pair of PD-A450 plastic/steel road pedals, BC 9/16 inch × 20 TPI thread. SI-P-89 specifies 565 g per pair but does not identify whether toe clips or straps are included or a weighed toe-clip size; no inclusion or exclusion is assumed.

technical_document.title: Shimano PD-A450 exploded view and replacement parts

sources.title: Shimano The New System Component Family for Every Riding Style, August 1988, page 10 (archived by Disraeli Gears)
Shimano SI-P-89, September 1987: PD-A450 pedal specifications; explicitly listed 565 g per pair
